name: Suggest a feed
description: Recommend an official RSS or Atom feed for the directory.
title: "[Feed]: "
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Have a ready documentation and OPML change? Please open a pull request instead. Use this form to suggest a feed or discuss whether it belongs in the directory.
  - type: input
    id: name
    attributes:
      label: Feed name
      description: The publisher and feed name as it should appear in the directory.
      placeholder: "Example: Example Publisher Blog"
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: feed-url
    attributes:
      label: RSS or Atom URL
      description: A directly importable feed URL, not a webpage URL.
      placeholder: https://example.com/feed.xml
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: homepage-url
    attributes:
      label: Official homepage
      description: The publisher page that establishes this as an official feed.
      placeholder: https://example.com/
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: category
    attributes:
      label: Suggested category
      options:
        - AI Papers and News
        - Big Tech Engineering Blogs
        - Tech Communities
        - Tech Newsletters
        - Developer Tool Releases
        - News
        - Academic Papers
        - Other (please explain below)
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: description
    attributes:
      label: Brief description
      description: Describe the content, audience, and why it belongs in this category.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: checkboxes
    id: verification
    attributes:
      label: Verification
      options:
        - label: I verified that the URL is not already listed and opens in an RSS reader or browser.
          required: true
        - label: I can open a pull request with the documentation and OPML changes.
          required: false

name: Report a broken feed
description: Report an existing directory entry that is unavailable or no longer a valid feed.
title: "[Broken feed]: "
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        If you already have a fix ready, please open a pull request. Include enough detail here for maintainers to reproduce the problem.
  - type: input
    id: name
    attributes:
      label: Feed name
      description: Use the name shown in README or the OPML directory.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: feed-url
    attributes:
      label: Feed URL
      description: The exact URL currently listed in this repository.
      placeholder: https://example.com/feed.xml
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: observed-problem
    attributes:
      label: Observed problem
      description: Include the HTTP status, parsing error, redirect, or other behavior you observed.
      placeholder: "HTTP 404; the URL no longer resolves to a feed."
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: checked-at
    attributes:
      label: Checked at
      description: Provide the date and time, including timezone if possible.
      placeholder: "2026-08-25 15:30 UTC+8"
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: reproduction
    attributes:
      label: How to reproduce
      description: Describe the browser, RSS reader, command, proxy, or network conditions used to observe the problem.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: replacement
    attributes:
      label: Possible replacement (optional)
      description: Share an official replacement feed URL if you found one.
